pages.text: $(thing)Patchouli$() is optional and supplies this in-game manual. Tobacconist's gameplay itself is not meant to require Patchouli. The manual recipe and contents are conditionally loaded when Patchouli is present.

$(thing)Curios$() is optional. With it installed, you gain the Eyes and Mouth accessory slots. Without it, Spectacles use the vanilla head slot and smoking still works through ordinary right-click use.
pages.title: Curios

pages.text: $(thing)JEI$() is optional. It provides recipe browsing and Tobacconist custom recipe categories, but every gameplay workflow needed to use the mod is described in this manual so JEI is not required as documentation.
pages.title: JEI

pages.text: $(thing)Farmer's Delight$() and $(thing)Fruits Delight$() add extra flavored-molasses recipes when installed. Their dedicated flavor entries appear in the Shisha & Hookahs category only when the matching mod is loaded.
pages.title: Food Mod Integrations
